patterns.what_worked: Installing the counter through main.lua's single hook line kept the scope boundary exact and made the OFF path provably byte-identical (wrap_onupdate returns the original function object), so bars_state's script==onupdate pin and main_init_state stayed green without edits.
patterns.what_was_hard: 'Per-site' is bounded by what main.lua owns: only the three hand-bar OnUpdate hooks; sub-handler attribution (class hook vs GCD markers vs ldb) would need bars.lua edits, out of the brief. Attribution seconds render '?' (not a fake 0.00s) when no clock was captured.
patterns.skill_gap: Offline harness cannot load the addon; in-client /st diag read and real attribution magnitudes stay UNCONFIRMED until the owner's test session.
